title: Private Tailscale SSH
description: Enable Tailscale without exposing dashboards. Enroll with sudo tailscale up, then SSH to its private address. Forward portal ports to 127.0.0.1 for HTTPS access using the existing local CA.
module: { ... }: { services.tailscale = { enable = true; openFirewall = false; useRoutingFeatures = "none"; }; networking.firewall.extraInputRules = ''iifname "tailscale0" ip saddr 100.64.0.0/10 tcp dport 22 accept''; }
